oracle_policy: Each adversarial case maps to one independently pinned cascade outcome. These checks require real FalkorDB in the later behavior task; this matrix is not live product evidence.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query a uniquely owned graph before adding the cascade fixture.
cases.setup: Create one fresh task-owned graph; do not seed any scenario records.
pinned_assertions: no scenario event exists
no impact paths are returned
the state is empty/unknown
no available state is invented
no service, role, or safe outcome is invented
cases.failure_detected: Warm/shared state or fabricated safe/default facts turn missing evidence into a known outcome.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Read the source-backed available FPU baseline without applying any scenario branch.
cases.setup: Use the synthetic SRC-TABLETOP-FPU-7 availability observation at 06:00Z and query mainline at 06:30Z.
pinned_assertions: EQ-FPU-7 is available at 2026-10-15T06:00:00Z
mainline at 06:30Z has exactly zero outage paths
no outage scenario branch was applied
cases.failure_detected: Hypothetical event leaks into observed/mainline state or the baseline is guessed from a branch.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Traverse an outage at the shared upstream facilities unit through both downstream logistics chains.
cases.setup: Add only EVT-FPU-OUTAGE-HYP-01 to BR-FPU-OUTAGE-DRILL with its pinned source/time; query at 06:30Z.
pinned_assertions: exact branch, event, source, and event timestamp
exact ordered dock-charger to receiving-dock role path
exact ordered linen-conveyor to linen-logistics role path
both paths are labeled hypothetical/simulated rather than observed
mainline/base topology remains unchanged
cases.failure_detected: Static path list, missing multi-hop dependency semantics, wrong role endpoint, extra/missing route, or hypothetical claim mislabeled as observed.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Remove only the owned FPU-to-dock-charger dependency in a second branch and compare exact path delta.
cases.setup: Fork BR-FPU-ISOLATE-DOCK-FEED from the same outage event/base topology; remove the dependency only in that branch.
pinned_assertions: the only branch-local mutation is EQ-FPU-7 to EQ-DOCK-CHARGER-2
counterfactual returns exactly the linen-conveyor path
outage branch still returns both pinned paths
mainline remains zero impact paths
reset/evaluation does not mutate the other branch or mainline
cases.failure_detected: Branch mutation leaks into mainline/other branch or the returned delta is not caused by the removed graph edge.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Load and mutate the new scenario in a graph that also carries existing INC-204/INC-207 cases.
cases.setup: Compare existing original, source-change, temporal, and shift-board oracle paths before and after cascade load, branch evaluation, and branch reset; retain legacy planner fixture as separate.
pinned_assertions: no path joins INC-204 or INC-207 to EQ-FPU-7
existing INC-204 original and temporal paths are unchanged
existing INC-204 shift-board paths are unchanged
existing INC-207 source-change and shift-board paths are unchanged
INC-LIFT-01 remains a distinct legacy oracle, not a cascade alias
cases.failure_detected: New graph mutation contaminates earlier incidents, their paths/provenance, or maps a legacy/current scenario by superficial similarity.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inject a restricted FPU source/event with distinctive secret markers and compare operations-scope API and graph output.
cases.setup: Capture the visible output, add only SRC-RESTRICTED-FPU-77-linked restricted facts, and query at the same operations scope.
pinned_assertions: API and visual-graph output remain equivalent before/after
restricted IDs/title/fact are not disclosed
hidden counts or existence are not disclosed
no restricted-derived path, role, or paraphrase leaks
cases.failure_detected: Direct or inferential restricted-source disclosure, including count/existence and graph-path leakage.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Challenge time normalization and invalid input, repeat the same seed, then query through a fresh client connection.
cases.setup: Compare offset 07:30+01:00 to 06:30Z; reject minute 61 before mutation; seed twice and reconnect to the same uniquely owned graph.
pinned_assertions: offset equals 2026-10-15T06:30:00Z and returns same pinned paths
malformed 06:61Z is rejected before branch/graph mutation
second identical seed creates no duplicate IDs/nodes/edges
a genuinely new client connection is used
mainline, outage branch, and isolation branch each return their pinned results after reconnect
cases.failure_detected: Timestamp confusion, partial invalid-input mutation, duplicate seed, warm-client cache, or branch drift after reconnect.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Inspect all graph and application effects of creating, evaluating, resetting, and cleaning up the simulation.
cases.setup: Use fictional facilities/logistics fixtures in an isolated graph and observe external-effect counters and cleanup ownership.
pinned_assertions: writes target only the unique task-owned synthetic graph
no message, call, ticket, service write, or external action occurs
no action/draft is automatically confirmed
paths remain non-clinical and no diagnosis/treatment/patient-impact/triage is inferred
no hospital-safety claim is made
cleanup deletes only the owned graph and stops only owned processes
cases.failure_detected: External or clinical action escapes the simulator boundary, or cleanup affects unowned resources.
